findings.title: Recreate exit code changed from 4 to 3, and 4 now means feature disabled
findings.body:
RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE was 4 and is now 3. Code 4 is reused for FEATURE_DISABLED.

Existing scripts, and the operator if it consumes this code, that treat exit code 4 as "recreate needed" will now get a different meaning for the same value. A disabled feature would be interpreted as a recreate decision, and real recreate results (3) would be treated as unknown errors.

Any consumer in the operator should be checked and updated together with this change.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test does not check exit code or the check subcommand
findings.body:
testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the error message for the metadata subcommand. It does not verify the new exit code 4.

It also does not cover the check subcommand. That leaves the new FEATURE_DISABLED contract untested.
